AI sides: pk = 1 + enqueue tick + min(group size, Q_SIZE_CAP=200)/2 (smaller groups first among same-age requests, a mass order is delayed at most 100 ticks behind a later single request: never starved). Out-of-order AI entries wait in sys_state.movement.qin (key present only while non-empty), merged at the next drain with O(n) slices.
